The marina features 270 wet slips with brand-new floating docks and dry storage options with easy launch and retrieval via the SpeedyDock app. Located near Ocean City and the Great Egg Harbor Inlet, it provides quick access to offshore and back bay boating.

quotes.text: Staff and service at this marina is first class! We purchased a boat that was kept here. Launch was handled professionally, all expectations exceeded 10 fold. We have dock space at home and live about 30 miles away – however I would not hesitate to keep my boat here otherwise. Marina also has an impressive dry indoor boat storage facility, I believe one of the few that offer this kind of service – saves the hassle of bottom paint.

First time boat owner and after talking with other marinas we felt All Seasons would be a good fit. Rachel and Jennifer in the main office are a pleasure to work with. The entire dock staff (Chris, John & Moe) totally went out of there way to check and make sure we felt confident and knew what to do and not to do. Dave in the service department runs an outstanding shop. I highly recommend All Seasons Marina!
